For non-unit alpha (all of 1+tau,2,1-tau,tau^2+1 have norm >=2) D_alpha is nonconstant, so N_alpha - L*D_alpha is a nonzero polynomial of degree <= max(N(alpha), 2^k+N(alpha)-1). That means agreement is at most 2*(2^k+N(alpha)-1) points of E, which is deterministic, with no baseline needed, and is O(2^k)/|E| -> 0. For units alpha=tau^j, x(tau^j P)=x^{2^j} is exactly additive (Frobenius), which is the only linear case and gives nothing for the DLP. So the hypothesis is true as a theorem, and the 'lever 14 reopens' branch is impossible for any L with 2^k << |E|. A general L of degree ~|E| interpolates anything, which is the random-function baseline. Nongenericity: none. The proposal is not an attack. It is a closure that a proof settles completely.
